title: Amazon 767 Overrun in Miami: What the NTSB Flight Data Shows
desc:
Amazon 767 runway overrun at Miami (21 Air Flight 7598, Sept 6, 2026), explained with NTSB preliminary data: flight data recorder, cockpit voice recorder timeline, weather, ATC and wreckage findings.

The Boeing 767 freighter touched down about 3,750 ft down runway 30, left the runway end at 113 knots and crossed a public road. Five people on the ground were killed. This is a breakdown of what the NTSB has published so far — not a finding of cause. The NTSB has not determined a probable cause.
